description.value:
You learn to blend your mastery of body and mind with your mystic arts to modify your spells and Unarmed Attacks; you gain two Metamystic options of your choice from the list below. You use the chosen options to temporarily modify one spell you cast, with additional benefits to your Unarmed Attacks as described. To use an option, you must spend the number of Ki Points that it costs. You can use only one Metamystic option on a spell and subsequent Unarmed Attacks this turn.

When you finish a Short or a Long Rest you can replace one metamystic art you know with another one.

Distant Arts

When you cast a spell on your turn that has a range of 30 feet or greater, you can spend 1 Ki point to also give that same range to your Unarmed Attacks this turn.

Empowered Arts

When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend a number of Ki points up to your Wisdom modifier to reroll a number of damage dice equal to the number of Ki points expended. You can then reroll the weapon damage die on a number of Unarmed Attacks you make this turn, up to the number of Ki points expended. You must use the new rolls.

Swift Arts

When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can spend 2 Ki points to cast one of your Sorcerer cantrips that has a cast time of an Action in place of one of the attacks.

Twinned Arts

When you cast a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, you can spend a number of Ki points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 Ki point if the spell is a cantrip). You can spend up to 4 additional Ki points. For each additiona Ki point expended, one of your Unarmed Attacks this turn can target a second creature within their reach, using the original attack and damage roll.

To be eligible, a spell must be incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell's current level. For example, Magic Missile and Scorching Ray aren't eligible, but Ray of Frost and Chromatic Orb are.
